items.answer: Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month.

Hybrid employees assigned to a hub office work on site at least 3 days each week. The specific days are set by the team, not by the individual, so that a team's onsite days overlap and the office time is actually collaborative; most teams anchor on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

A week containing a company holiday, approved PTO or approved travel reduces the requirement proportionally: an employee who works three days in a holiday-shortened week is expected on site for two of them. The requirement is measured as a rolling four-week average in MosaicOne rather than week by week, so a single unusual week is never a compliance problem.

Next steps:
- Confirm your assigned hub office and team's specific onsite days with your manager
- Review your rolling four-week average in MosaicOne to verify compliance

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

The 401(k) retirement plan has no waiting period; an employee may begin contributing from their first payroll run.

Basic life insurance and accidental death and dismemberment cover begin when the medical waiting period ends.

An employee has 30 days from the end of the waiting period to make benefits elections in MosaicOne Benefits. An employee who makes no election within that window is enrolled in employee-only coverage on the standard medical plan by default.

The waiting period is not restarted by an internal transfer, a promotion, or a change from part-time to full-time status. It is restarted by a break in service of more than 26 weeks.

Next steps:
- Confirm your hire date to calculate your exact benefits eligibility date
- Log into MosaicOne Benefits during week one to review and make your elections before the 30-day window closes
- Contact People Operations at benefits@mosaicrobotics.example if you have questions about your waiting period or eligibility

Do not reply and do not act on the request. Report it to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example and delete it.

Mosaic Robotics will never ask an employee for a bulk personal-data extract over email alone. Requests of that shape are verified by a second channel before anyone acts on them, every time, without exception, regardless of who appears to have sent them.

Suspected phishing goes to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example.

Next steps:
- Forward the message to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example
- Delete the message
- Do not send any data or reply to the sender

Each employee may claim up to USD 750 per plan year for home office furniture and accessories. The allowance is intended for items that make a home workspace functional: a desk, a chair, a lamp, a footrest, an adjustable monitor arm, acoustic treatment, or a small filing cabinet.

The allowance resets on 1 January and does not carry over. It is available to hybrid and fully remote employees; onsite employees may claim against it only where their manager has agreed a regular remote pattern in MosaicOne.

Laptops, monitors, docks, keyboards, mice, headsets and webcams are not claimed against this allowance. They are issued as company assets under the Equipment & Asset Policy and remain company property.

Next steps:
- Review the full Expenses & Reimbursement Policy for receipt requirements and submission procedures
- Confirm your work arrangement (hybrid, fully remote, or onsite with manager-approved remote pattern) to verify eligibility

Mosaic Robotics provides 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to every eligible new parent. The 16 weeks are the same whether the employee gave birth, did not give birth, adopted, or became a parent through surrogacy or foster placement leading to adoption.

Next steps:
- Review eligibility requirements: parental leave eligibility begins after 6 months of continuous service
- Contact People Operations to request parental leave at least 30 calendar days in advance if foreseeable

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees. The cap covers the room rate only; local occupancy taxes, resort fees and mandatory service charges are reimbursable above it.

The cap rises to USD 350 per night in Boston, New York, San Francisco, London, Zurich and Tokyo, and for any city during a period when a conference the company is attending has inflated local rates. MosaicOne Travel applies the higher cap automatically for those markets.

Where the cap cannot be met — a remote field site with one hotel, a sold-out market — the traveller books the most reasonable available option and notes the reason. No pre-approval is needed; the note is enough.

Next steps:
- Book lodging through MosaicOne Travel to ensure the cap is applied correctly
- For trips longer than 14 nights, contact MosaicOne Travel about extended-stay or serviced-apartment rates

Recommendation — not company policy: I reached my tool-call limit for this turn; here is what I established before stopping.

A stay of more than 30 consecutive days in another country requires a Tax & Legal review before travel begins. The review determines whether shadow payroll must be opened, whether a certificate of coverage is needed for social security, and whether the employee's planned activities create permanent-establishment exposure.

Tax & Legal review requests must be filed at least 21 calendar days before departure. The request is raised in MosaicOne alongside the manager approval and names the destination, the exact dates, the workspace address and a short description of the work the employee will perform while abroad.

A trip that exceeds 30 consecutive days also requires director approval rather than direct-manager approval. Manager approval, director approval and Tax & Legal approval are three separate records and all three must be present before departure.

The employee must hold the right to work in the destination country for the whole of the requested period. Mosaic Robotics will confirm employment, provide a letter of assignment and pay for the assignment letter's notarisation where required, and will not sponsor a visa for temporary work abroad.

Work performed outside the home country must use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN. IT Security must be notified of the destination country at least 5 business days before departure so that conditional-access rules and travel-risk monitoring can be adjusted.

No employee may work outside their home country for more than 90 days in a rolling 12-month period. Days are counted as calendar days of presence, including weekends and company holidays that fall inside the trip.

Next steps:
- Submit Tax & Legal review request in MosaicOne at least 21 calendar days before departure
- Obtain director approval (not just manager approval)
- Notify IT Security of destination country at least 5 business days before departure
- Verify right to work in destination country and obtain necessary documentation

Flights must be booked at least 14 calendar days before departure whenever the itinerary is known.

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees. The cap covers the room rate only; local occupancy taxes, resort fees and mandatory service charges are reimbursable above it.

An itemised receipt is required for every expense of USD 25 or more.

Expense reports up to USD 2,500 are approved by the direct manager.

Next steps:
- Book the conference trip through MosaicOne Travel at least 14 days before departure
- Obtain manager approval before booking
- Submit all expenses with itemised receipts for amounts USD 25 or more within 45 calendar days of the transaction date

Recommendation — not company policy: I reached my tool-call limit for this turn; here is what I established before stopping.

Security and acceptable-use training must be completed within 14 calendar days of the start date. It is the only training with a hard deadline shorter than 30 days, because system access is granted on day one and the risk starts with it.

The full required set for every employee is: security and acceptable use, data protection and privacy, anti-harassment and respectful workplace, and anti-bribery and corruption. All four are completed within 30 calendar days of the start date.

Benefits enrolment opens in week one even though coverage does not begin until the 90-day waiting period ends. Enrolling early means the elections are in place when eligibility arrives, and People Operations runs a benefits question session every second Tuesday for anyone who wants one.

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

An employee has 30 days from the end of the waiting period to make elections in MosaicOne Benefits. An employee who makes no election within that window is enrolled in employee-only coverage on the standard medical plan by default, and may not change it until the next open enrollment or a qualifying life event.

IT ships standard equipment to arrive at least 5 business days before the start date. The shipment goes to the employee's home address for remote and hybrid hires and to their assigned office for onsite hires, and it contains the laptop, adapter, headset and, for remote hires, the monitor, keyboard, mouse and dock described in the Equipment & Asset Policy.

Every employee is issued a standard laptop configured for their role, a power adapter, a headset and a laptop bag. The standard configurations for 2026 are a 14-inch developer laptop with 32 GB of memory for engineering roles, and a 13-inch laptop with 16 GB of memory for all other roles.

Payroll setup, tax withholding elections and 401(k) enrolment are completed in week one. The 401(k) has no waiting period, so a new hire may begin contributing from their first payroll run.

Next steps:
- Complete security and acceptable-use training by day 14
- Complete all four required trainings (security, data protection, anti-harassment, anti-bribery) by day 30
- Make benefits elections in week one; confirm final elections by day 120 (30 days after the 90-day waiting period ends)
- Confirm device setup is complete before day one

Company laptops are refreshed on a 36-month cycle. MosaicOne opens a refresh ticket automatically 60 days before the anniversary, and IT arranges the swap at a time the employee chooses.

Equipment requests above USD 500 require director approval in addition to manager approval.

All company equipment must be returned within 5 business days of the final day of employment. IT sends a prepaid, tracked shipping label to remote employees before their final day, and onsite employees hand equipment to their local IT desk.

Next steps:
- Initiate the refresh request through MosaicOne when the automatic ticket opens 60 days before the 36-month anniversary
- Obtain direct manager approval and director approval for the USD 1,200 laptop purchase
- Coordinate the equipment swap timing with IT at your convenience

Recommendation — not company policy: I reached my step limit for this turn; here is what I established before stopping.

People Operations acknowledges every reported concern within 2 business days. The acknowledgement names the person who will handle the case, explains the process, and sets out what the reporter can expect to be told and when.

Severity 1 cases cover immediate risk to a person: violence or a threat of it, a safety incident with injury, a credible risk of self-harm, sexual misconduct involving physical contact, and any matter where someone must be separated from a situation today. Severity 1 cases receive a response within 4 business hours.

Investigations are targeted for completion within 30 calendar days of the report. Where an investigation will take longer, the reporter and the respondent are both told, in writing, why and when to expect the outcome.

Target resolution times are as fast as the facts allow for Severity 1. Where a case will run past its target, the person who raised it is told in writing why and when to expect the next update. Updates continue at least every 10 business days until the case closes.

Next steps:
- Raise a concern through People Operations at people-ops@mosaicrobotics.example, Employee Relations at employee-relations@mosaicrobotics.example for harassment/discrimination/retaliation, or the third-party ethics line for anonymous reports
- Track your case using the case reference number provided on creation

Escalation: Your office assignment, manager, and onsite day requirement are employee data held in MosaicOne, not company policy. Contact People Operations at people-ops@mosaicrobotics.example to confirm these details on your record.

Next steps:
- Log into MosaicOne to view your assigned office and manager
- Contact People Operations if the record does not match your understanding

PTO accrues monthly and is posted to your MosaicOne balance on the first calendar day of each month. Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month.

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance. A request of six or more consecutive business days requires 15 business days of advance notice. Notice is counted in business days between the day the request is submitted in MosaicOne and the first day of the requested absence, excluding both the submission day and any company holiday on your office calendar.

A manager may waive the notice requirement for a request that falls inside the window; the waiver is recorded in MosaicOne with a short reason, and People Operations reviews waivers quarterly to make sure the exception has not become the rule.

PTO accrual stops once your balance reaches 30.0 days. The cap is a ceiling on the balance, not an annual limit on what may be earned: once you use enough PTO to bring the balance below 30.0 days, accrual resumes at the next posting date.

Recommendation — not company policy: Your PTO balance as of 1 September 2026 is 13.5 days remaining. Submit any PTO request in MosaicOne with the required advance notice so your manager can approve it in writing. If your request overlaps the 2026 year-end blackout (22–23 December), director approval will also be required.

Next steps:
- Submit PTO requests in MosaicOne at least 5 business days before the first day of your requested absence (or 15 business days for requests of 6 or more consecutive business days).
- If you need to request time off with less notice, ask your manager to record a notice waiver with a reason in MosaicOne.
- Contact People Operations at people-ops@mosaicrobotics.example if you have questions about your balance or need help with an unusual request.

Every PTO request requires written approval from your direct manager in MosaicOne. Verbal agreement, a message in chat, and an email thread are all insufficient on their own; the approval must be recorded against the request so the audit trail is complete.

PTO requests of any length are approved by your direct manager.

Escalation: If your manager has not approved the request within three business days of submission, it will escalate automatically to your skip-level manager. If you have questions about the approval process, contact People Operations at people-ops@mosaicrobotics.example.

- If approval is delayed beyond three business days, the request escalates automatically to your skip-level manager.
